query.query: How do I adjust section heights in the Wix Editor? Provide guidance on resizing and setting section heights in the Wix Editor.

0.25.answer: To adjust section heights in the Wix Editor, click the section and drag its stretch handles to make it bigger or smaller. When you resize elements, the size of the page or section may automatically adjust to fit the element [Efe6617c432ad]. You can also use the Editor toolbar to enter exact width and height values for more precise resizing [E24f56e5f98f1]. If you're trying to change the overall page length rather than a section, use the Page Height handle at the bottom of the page (or top of the footer if your page has one) [Ec243d8b888c6].

Ec243d8b888c6.title: Wix Editor: Changing the Length of Your Page
Ec243d8b888c6.text:
Wix Editor: Changing the Length of Your Page
Your site pages do not have a predetermined size, and they automatically adjust their length to accommodate the content you add to them. This ensures that your information and elements aren't cut off on your live site. You can manually change the length of your pages to make them longer or shorter, depending on your layout and content needs.In this article, learn more about:
Changing the length of your page FAQsChanging your page lengthResize your page with the Page Height handle in the editor. You can find this handle in different places on your site, depending on whether you do or don't have a footer on that page. To change the height of a page that has a footer:
Click your footer. Click and drag the Adjust Page Height handle on the top of the footer to the desired position.To change the height of a page without a footer:
Click your page. Click and drag the Adjust Page Height handle at the bottom of the page to the desired position.Note:This option is only available if you have chosen the No Header & Footer layout for your page. FAQsCan each page be a different length?Your site's pages can all have different lengths. This also applies to your mobile site.Can I reset the height of my page?Absolutely. Just double-click the Adjust Page Height handle to reset the height of your page. I'm clicking the Page Height Handle but it isn't moving. Why not?If your page isn't resizing, there may be an element that's getting in the way. For example, you cannot make a page shorter if doing so will cut off an element at the bottom of the page. In order to resize your page length, you need to move or delete the element first. Note: If you can't find the element, you can use the Layers panel to locate it.What are the minimum and maximum lengths my page can be?Your page length can be a minimum of 500 pixels, and a maximum of 60,000 pixels. Pages with more content take longer to load than those with less content and elements. query.query: How do I manage the categories that my booking services are in on my Wix website?

0.25.answer:
I'd be happy to help you manage the categories for your booking services on your Wix site. Here's what you can do:

**Create a category:** Go to **Booking Services** in your site's dashboard, click **Manage Categories**, then **+ Add New Category**. Enter a name and click **Add** [E6ffe202cfad0].

**Assign a service to a category:** In **Booking Services**, select the service, click the **Service category** drop-down, choose the category, and click **Save**. Note that a service can only be in one category at a time [E6ffe202cfad0].

**Reorder services and categories:** In **Booking Services**, select a category from the drop-down at the top, then drag services into your preferred order. To reorder categories, click **Manage Categories** and drag them. You can only reorder services within their categories, not in the "All categories" list [E6ffe202cfad0].

**Rename a category:** Click **Manage Categories**, hover over the category, click **Edit Name**, enter the new name, and click **Save** [E6ffe202cfad0].

**Delete a category:** Click **Manage Categories**, hover over the category, click **Delete**. You can then choose to move its services to another category, or permanently delete the category and its services. Deleting services cannot be undone [E6ffe202cfad0].

Is there a specific task you'd like help with, such as creating a new category or moving a service?

query.query: How do I adjust section heights in the Wix Editor?

0.5.answer:
To adjust a section's height in the Wix Editor, click the section, then click and drag the **Adjust section height handle** at the bottom of the section to make it taller or shorter [E42f07b592904]. The smallest size you can make a section is 40px [E42f07b592904].

For more precise sizing, you can also click the section and enter a specific number in the **H field** on the Editor toolbar to set the height [Ed82af59cbdad].

Note that sections don't automatically adjust their height for different viewports or screen sizes, but you can resize them manually in the mobile Editor using the stretch handles [E5cb6ed0051b8].
